q: Remember every rejection email. Remember every 'not good enough'. Today you sit down and prove them wrong — one problem at a time.
You failed because you stopped, not because you couldn't. Don't stop today.
Fall down seven times, stand up eight.
The cave you fear to enter holds the treasure you seek.
Pain is weakness leaving the body. Every solved problem is one less weakness.
Every interview you bombed was rehearsal. Today is the show.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
A river cuts through rock not because of its power, but because of its persistence.
You are not the failure of your past. You are the warrior of your present.
Hard times create strong men. Strong men create good times. Don't be the soft man.
It is not the critic who counts. The credit belongs to the man in the arena, whose face is marred by dust and sweat and blood.
Suffer the pain of discipline or suffer the pain of regret.
When you feel like quitting, remember why you started.
The wound is the place where the light enters you.
Discipline equals freedom. Today you choose freedom.
If you're going through hell, keep going.
Don't pray for an easy life. Pray for the strength to endure a difficult one.
Champions aren't made in the gym. They're made from something deep inside — a desire, a dream, a vision.
You miss every problem you don't attempt. Every. Single. One.
The expert in anything was once the disaster you used to be.
Failure is the seasoning that gives success its flavor.
You will never be ready. Start anyway. Bleed anyway. Win anyway.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
Every master was once a disaster. Every disaster who didn't quit became a master.
The phoenix must burn to emerge.
Don't count the days. Make the days count.
He who is not courageous enough to take risks will accomplish nothing in life.
The pain you feel today will be the strength you feel tomorrow.
A warrior is not afraid of the dark. He carries the fire into it.
You don't drown by falling in water. You drown by staying there. Get up.
The strongest steel is forged in the hottest fire. Welcome the heat.
Comfort is the enemy of progress. Sit in the chair until the problem cracks.
Scars are tattoos with better stories. Each failed attempt is a scar earned.
You were not put on this earth to be average. Stop acting like it.
The man who fails seven times and stands up eight is not lucky. He is dangerous.
Don't wait for the storm to pass. Learn to fight in the rain.
The grind doesn't lie. The reps don't lie. Sit down and put in the work.
When the world burns down around you, build something out of the ashes.
Your past failures didn't bury you. They planted you. Now bloom.
One more problem. Always one more. That's how warriors are built.
